summary: General spectral-radius rate is false; APG theorem fails under its printed hypotheses.

problems.title: Individual spectral radii do not control varying products
problems.claim: Theorem2.7 bounds derivative error using limsup individual spectral radius and primal rate.

Primal rate1/4 and zero derivative variation

problems.result: Each spectral radius1/4, but derivative error2^-k contradicts polynomial(k)(3/8)^k for delta1/8.
problems.counterevidence: Qualitative convergence survives; structured quadratic PGD has a common metric; convergent Jacobian sequence can use limiting adapted norm.

correction.statement: Common norm/product-growth rate needed; all constants not re-proved
